motivation.zh: 明确如何用已登记的三项分解和两项误差界，把高高项的单侧下界转为完整次弧的单侧下界。仍须对每个充分大的偶数证明高高项下界。
motivation.en: Record how the published three-term decomposition and two error estimates transfer a signed high-high bound to the full minor arcs. The high-high bound is still needed for every sufficiently large even target.

plain_statement.zh: 给定次弧三项分解、低低项与低高项的次线性范数界，以及高高项的逐偶数单侧下界，推出完整次弧的逐偶数单侧下界。
plain_statement.en: Deduce the one-sided minor-arc bound for all sufficiently large even targets from the three-term decomposition, sublinear norm bounds for the low-low and low-high terms, and the one-sided bound for the high-high term.

brief.zh: 对任意正误差 ε，分别用 ε/4 调用三个估计，取三个阈值的最大值。用复数实部的绝对值不超过范数，并计入低高项前的系数 2。
brief.en: Apply each of the three estimates at ε/4 and take the maximum of their thresholds. Bound the absolute real part by the complex norm and retain the coefficient 2 on the mixed term.

explanation.zh: 分解恒等式和两个范数界控制低段误差，高高项下界给出剩余的有符号估计。四个输入共同推出父命题。
explanation.en: The identity and two norm bounds control the low terms. The high-high bound supplies the remaining signed estimate. All four inputs together imply the parent proposition.

route_note.zh: 两条攻关任务采用同一套弧宽、权和阈值定义。两项估计若都成立，可得到充分大偶数的结论，阈值以下仍需另证。次弧分解中低高项出现两次。低低、低高和高高三项若各使用 ε/4 的预算，合计给出 ε 的逐偶数单侧预算。
route_note.en: Both research targets use the same arcs and weights. Together they would cover sufficiently large evens. Values below the resulting threshold require a separate proof. The mixed term occurs twice in the minor-arc decomposition. Assigning ε/4 to each of the low-low, mixed and high-high bounds gives a total one-sided error budget of ε at each sufficiently large even target.
